eventDetail.scope: As global challenges such as climate change, energy scarcity, rapid urbanization, and resource depletion intensify, there is an increasing need for secure, intelligent, and sustainable technologies that promote environmental stewardship and societal resilience. The International Conference on Advanced Secure and Sustainable Enabling Technologies (ASSETech) provides a multidisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and policymakers to exchange innovative ideas and research on AI, IoT, cybersecurity, smart systems, renewable energy, green computing, sustainable manufacturing, and other enabling technologies. The conference aims to foster collaboration and accelerate the development of secure, intelligent, and sustainable solutions that contribute to the UN Sustainable Development Goals and a technology-driven sustainable future.
